consigna: One sustained spoken production of at least ten minutes: make the case for a change at work or in your building to a listener who is not convinced — with a summary of the situation, an opinion that holds, and a negotiated offer. With a person, or recorded alone. Planning in notes is preparation; what counts is spoken.
requisitos: A summary with the conclusion in the first two sentences (week 7)
An opinion with a reason and an acknowledged limit (week 8)
Two conditional offers and one reframe from position to interest (week 9)
Four professional collocations, no broken pairings (week 3)
microtareas: *Mon (10 min).* Reread your corrected work from weeks 2 to 9 and write down the correction that appeared most often.
*Wed (5 min).* Write three consecutive sentences that carry a summary, a collocation and a reduced relative.
*Fri (10 min).* Record the ten minutes. Then listen to the first minute only: does the structure hold from the start?
autochequeo: Are all six skills present, or did one crowd out the others?
Did the banned words creep back once I stopped watching?
Was the limit on my opinion real or decorative?
Did I speak, or deliver a written text?
promptCorreccion: This is a review of six skills at once: summarising, opinion with a limit, negotiating, professional collocations, reduced relatives and lexical precision. (1) For each, say whether it is present and whether it is done well. (2) Say which collapsed under the weight of the others. (3) Give me one sentence that would have carried three of them at once. Correct nothing outside these six areas. ---
